body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: a2ae22793d991b12186c60a736547dd9897dd71f -->
**Verdict: no blocker found. The maintainer decides on the two open notes below.**

**What looks good**
- The two full test bodies are unchanged. The only change to each is the new `#[ignore]` line.
- Each `_light` twin is in the same file as its full test. Each twin runs one case with the same `check_cleared` call and the same inputs as the full test (neck 48x30 D6; island 30x30 D6).
- The `#[test]` count goes up by one in each file (2 to 3), so by two in total. No test is removed.
- The ignore reasons use the format of #3726: `heavy lane: motion heavy: <binary> (<n> s alone in debug, #3514)` and `light lane: ...; the full test is <name>`.
- The decision file has the numbers of the PR body (167.9 s, 153.9 s, 50.2 s, 29.2 s). The two kept tests stay in the default suite.
- Only test files and one decision file change. No process file, no dependency, no snapshot PNG.

**Results merged with main (01e177bf5), locally, debug**
- Trial merge: clean.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-motion --test adaptive_troch_island --test adaptive_troch_neck`:
  - island: 1 passed (`ring_round_island_is_cleared_with_closed_lane`, 51.09 s), 2 ignored (full test, twin).
  - neck: 0 passed, 3 ignored (the full test, the twin and the older `l_shaped...` test).
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion --test adaptive_troch_neck --test adaptive_troch_island -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light --dry-run`: lists `motion light: adaptive_troch_island` and `motion light: adaptive_troch_neck`, with the exact twin names.
- `cargo xtask gate release --dry-run`: lists `motion heavy: adaptive_troch_island` and `motion heavy: adaptive_troch_neck`.
- The 167.9 s and 153.9 s alone-times, and the 29.2 s time of the parallel test, are the author's numbers. This review did not repeat them. The 50.2 s time of the ring test agrees with the 51.09 s above.

**Light lane:** not run (owner decision pending on the permission refusal). The author's release run of the two twins (18.8 s and 13.2 s) is the only reading of them. This is not a pass.

**Heavy lanes:** not run in this review. The diff reaches `motion heavy: adaptive_troch_island` and `motion heavy: adaptive_troch_neck` (and the lanes that depend on `motion`). The PR body names no author run of them, and says they run at the cut. This is not a pass.

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. The full tests are not run by any gate until the cut. The twins cover only one case each (the 60x60 triangle and the 48x40 D10 island are in the full tests only).
2. The `_light` twins copy the case bodies. A change to a case in the full test needs the same change in the twin.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
